correctness.rationale: The directed-Euler-trail criterion is necessary and sufficient; proof partitions into active support sizes one, two, three. For three vertices, signed triangle differences give exact C0/C1 series, connectivity subtraction removes all and only forbidden disconnected matrices, and loop factors are independent. Boundary m=0 is counted once. The standard-library verifier confirms all 3^n words n=1..10 and independently enumerates all connected degree-balanced arc matrices n=1..8. The asymptotic comes from the unique pole of maximum order seven.

evidence: Kiah et al. arXiv:1410.8837v2, Theorem 4.5: for read length two, unrestricted profile number is asymptotically (q²−q+1) times the closed count (relative error O(n^(−2q))). Table I gives the closed ternary leading constant 1/8640.

broader_coverage.reasoning: The known general asymptotic theorem DOES cover the leading ternary coefficient 7/8640, so neither the seventh-order leading factor nor mere existence of polynomial growth is considered original. However the theorem supplies no exact n-dependent rational series and no lower-order terms. In the present case l=2, the 2016 exact short-word regime covers only n=2 and n=3, not n≥4.

value.rationale: A finite observation of ordered adjacent-pair multiplicities is a standard sequence-reconstruction and storage channel; exact class count equals maximum zero-error code cardinality. The new all-length rational generating function gives exact counts at every length for the first nonbinary alphabet and resolves boundary contributions invisible to previously known cyclic counts. It supplies significantly more than the prior general growth constant and avoids arbitrary-parameter table extensions.
